name: Back-end with Python: Django and FastAPI
summary: The Python route to the server: two frameworks, two styles, the same professional result.
syllabus: Django: the framework that comes with everything
topics: Choosing between Django and FastAPI: what each one assumes
Django: project, apps, urls and views
Django ORM: models, queries and migrations
Django admin and the value of a free back office
Django REST Framework: serializers and viewsets
FastAPI: routes, Pydantic typing and automatic validation
FastAPI: automatic documentation (OpenAPI) and dependency injection
Asynchrony in Python: async/await and when it actually helps
SQLAlchemy and Alembic for those not using Django
Authentication: session, token and JWT in both frameworks
Testing with pytest and the test client
Environment variables, per-environment configuration and secrets
Serving in production: Gunicorn, Uvicorn and a reverse proxy
